e10.line: The ‘C-x x g’ keystroke is bound to the ‘revert-buffer-quick’
e10.why: The text says revert-buffer-quick is like revert-buffer (it reverts the buffer to the saved file, discarding edits) and only prompts less, so it alone does what was asked.
The text says this command acts like revert-buffer, going back to the saved version of the file, while preserving markers and overlays, so on its own it discards the edits and reloads from disk.
